summary: Install Godot 4.3 outside the repo and export a real world viewer executable locally

coordination.notes: No source is changed by this increment; it only establishes that a viewer can be built on this machine, which B2 and B3 depend on. Godot lives at C:/Users/Admin/dev/tools/godot, outside every repo, and the same 4.3-stable zip and export-template tpz named by .github/workflows/release.yml were used so a local export cannot diverge from CI's. An earlier partial download of the tpz was already on disk at 226 MB against a Content-Length of 1073228327 and unzip -t could not find its central directory; it was re-fetched rather than trusted, because a truncated template archive exports an executable that is wrong in ways nothing here would notice.

checks: unzip -t on the re-fetched export templates -> 'No errors detected', 1073228327 bytes, version.txt says 4.3.stable
GODOT4=<that exe> npm run godot:export -> exit 0, 'Verified Windows viewer export: 84365552 bytes, sha256 863540270e5bb925fcaede9488b44ec6d0ddb251348453d6a0582eedfc96c6c5'

Two non-fatal findings recorded for other lanes: rcedit is absent so the export warns 'Could not start rcedit executable' and skips version resources, and godot/tests/live_bridge_transport_test.gd fails to parse under 4.3 because OS.get_temp_dir() does not exist in that version.
